defects.what: Antlers are smooth, pale, untextured tubes with spike tips; read as plastic/pipe, no bone grain, no burr at the base.
defects.fix: Add bone texture with longitudinal grain, darker stained base, knobbly burr ring where the antler meets the skull plate.

defects.where: Tile 6 close-up, left side of post near top
defects.what: Antlers are held by a single flat grey plate bracket screwed on the side; no skull, no bone plate, odd for a hunting trophy post.
defects.fix: Mount a skull cap on the post top (or a wooden shield) and seat the antler bases into it.

defects.what: Post is a bare cylinder with a few nail marks at roughly even spacing; no split, lean or moss, flat top.
defects.fix: Add a weathered chamfered top, vertical split, and moss at the base.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a pole with antlers; the pale tubes look fake and the bracket looks like a coat hook.

defects.what: Bottles are flat uniform green/brown with a clean plastic gloss; no glass transparency, dirt, moss, scratches, labels or soil contact.
defects.fix: Use semi-transparent dark glass with dirt and dust film, half-buried in leaf litter, with a scuffed lower rim.

defects.what: Faceted cylinder edges are visible on the large lying green bottle (polygonal outline).
defects.fix: Raise radial segments to 16+ or smooth the normals on the body.

defects.what: All four bottles share an identical profile with no variation (chip, missing neck, label).
defects.fix: Vary one bottle (broken neck, label remnant) and add the lip ring.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Fine as green and brown bottles from 2 m but looks like clean plastic toys.

defects.what: Row of black triangles at the base reads as holes cut through the metal but are painted flat black; looks like a decal strip.
defects.fix: Either model them as real notches in the bottom hoop or remove.

defects.what: Grey-silver blotches over orange rust are the same mottled noise everywhere, looking like camouflage rather than rust that starts at seams, the rim and the bottom.
defects.fix: Concentrate rust at the base, the seam and the rim; keep the upper wall mostly dull galvanised.

defects.what: Wooden/cloth grip is a smooth tube with faceted end.
defects.fix: Round the ends and add a wire tie.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Clearly a rusty bucket; only the base band and noisy blotches look off.

defects.where: Audit floating: group at (3.71,0.61,0) lowest 0.52 m; tile 1 near stump at left
defects.what: Small 0.48 m item hovers 0.52 m above ground; likely the axe in the stump but needs to be confirmed to touch the stump top.
defects.fix: Sink the blade into the stump so the head overlaps the wood.

defects.what: Gap between window lintel and log above shows dark slats/bars through; frame floats below the log course.
defects.fix: Add a lintel log above the window and close the opening to the frame.

defects.what: Roof sheets are lifted and rafters exposed, which reads as damage but the lifted sheet edges float with air gaps and visible sky.
defects.fix: Show a bent sheet resting on the purlins, with a cut hole sized to the missing sheet.

defects.what: Hanging lantern and its wire are deliberate hanging parts (OK) but not visible in sheet.
defects.fix: Confirm wire is attached to the porch beam.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Strong cabin silhouette with good log ends and chimney; porch rails and lifted roof sheets look slightly loose.

defects.what: Top stone has a pinched star-shaped crease or pucker on the upper surface, a mesh artefact.
defects.fix: Rebuild the top stone with a smooth dome or flat face.

defects.what: Same speckled grey-black pattern on every stone with identical scale; reads as a repeated texture.
defects.fix: Offset UVs and vary scale per stone; add lichen only on top faces.

defects.what: Stones are lens-shaped discs with little contact patch; the stack would topple.
defects.fix: Give each stone a flat bearing face.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a stack of stones; moss is nice but faceted discs look manufactured.

defects.where: Audit floating group at (1.73,0.35,1.13), size 0.08x0.16x0.03, lowest 0.33 m
defects.what: A small part floats with no contact (probably a tag or peg), failing the auto gate.
defects.fix: Attach it to the cooler or the tent or drop it to the ground.

defects.what: Brown smooth-lumped dirt mound under a tarp reads as a clay blob with a small stones row; unsupported and shapeless.
defects.fix: Model a tarp over a pile of gear with folds and ropes, or remove.

defects.what: Tent is a flat green plane with no seams, pegs hidden and ridge line thin; canvas has the same cloud-noise everywhere.
defects.fix: Add seams, grommets, sag between guy lines and stitching.

defects.what: Two tall poles with prop sticks lean at very different angles.
defects.fix: Plant props at consistent angles.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a camp from the tent and fire ring; scattered items feel placed in a row and the mound is off.

defects.what: Cans hang from the wire at near-equal spacing and same height pattern, rhythm too regular; strings are hairlines.
defects.fix: Vary spacing and drop length, and use real twine thickness.

defects.what: Right pole leans much harder than the left and has no guy or anchor; the strung wire would pull it over.
defects.fix: Add a guy stay or equalise the lean.

defects.what: Cans are plain cylinders with a flat top; no open lip or label.
defects.fix: Open the top and add a rim.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads at range as a wire with cans; the cans are tiny and simple.

defects.what: Same star-crack decal on every can end; identical across all cans.
defects.fix: Vary the end textures and rotate UVs.

defects.what: Pale flat lid is a faceted 10-gon disc, untextured, standing on edge like a sign.
defects.fix: Bend the lid with a rolled edge and raise segments to 16+.

defects.what: Flat orange label panel looks painted-on with a hard seam.
defects.fix: Add torn, partial label paper with a wrapped edge.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as rusty cans; the repeated end decal and faceted lid show up at 1 m.

defects.what: The model sits toppled, with the seat panel vertical and the legs lying flat; the silhouette does not read as a chair and in tile 3 the rail log looks like a loose beam.
defects.fix: Confirm orientation; if it is meant to be a toppled chair, bend the legs to rest on the ground; otherwise export upright.

defects.what: Wide panel has horizontal grain bands repeated across the whole surface with the same knot and crack mark at the same spot.
defects.fix: Break the seat into 3 boards with different grain.

defects.what: Armrests are thick log stubs with a single nail and no joint into the legs.
defects.fix: Add a notched or pegged joint.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Hard to recognise as a chair; reads as a pile of timber.

defects.what: Dark peeling streaks repeat at the same heights across many planks, and the green ivy blotches at the base are the same shape.
defects.fix: Break up the peeling per-plank and vary the base growth.

defects.what: Siding texture is smeared horizontally (stretched blur) with no plank grain and no gap between boards.
defects.fix: Raise texel density and add visible plank overlaps.

defects.what: Dark gaps at the eave above the windows show through to the interior; torn roof sheet hovers above the ridge.
defects.fix: Close the soffit with a fascia board and rest the lifted sheet on rafters.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Strong chapel silhouette with cupola and cemetery; paint streaks and base blotches look patterned.

defects.what: The same white scratch/knot decal with a cross tick recurs on board after board, as do broad pale bands on the lid edge (tile 4).
defects.fix: Offset UVs per board and remove the identical white decal.

defects.what: Corner posts splay outward and extend above the lid with nothing fixing the lid to them; lid seems to rest on the sides.
defects.fix: Cut the posts flush at lid height, add cleats under the lid.

defects.what: Single rust plate hasp has no hinge or lock.
defects.fix: Add a hinge pair and hasp.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a chunky crate; repeated white blotches look like decals.

defects.what: Ladder top passes beside a missing wall panel and ends on the floor edge with no hatch; the gap in the wall reads as a hole rather than an entrance.
defects.fix: Cut a proper hatch in the deck and add a handrail on each side of the opening.

defects.what: Cabin floor is a thin slab with no joists beneath; the four legs carry it only by a ring brace.
defects.fix: Add two cross joists under the deck and bolt them to the legs.

defects.what: Wood blocks on the roof sheet and a thin corrugated sheet overhang with no purlins visible.
defects.fix: Add purlins and fix the sheet with screws.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads well as a hunting tower with X bracing; the cabin deck and ladder entry are weakest.
